title: PersonQA Disclosed Build and Evaluation Process

nodes.label:
Establish the Disclosure Boundary
Evidence is limited to system cards
No standalone paper or repository
Do not infer an unpublished pipeline

Use Public Facts About People
This source basis is officially stated
Questions target person-level facts
Fact sources themselves are not listed

Cover 18 Fact Categories
Category count is officially stated
Category names are not published
Per-category balance is not published

Form Person Fact QA Records
Questions pair with reference facts
Composition is disclosed at high level
Authoring procedure is not disclosed

Item Count Not Disclosed
No train validation test sizes
No person or question totals
No split policy is public

Source Selection Not Disclosed
No collection or exclusion rules
No reference date or refresh cadence
No provenance fields are public

Annotation Protocol Not Disclosed
No annotator qualifications
No independent review or adjudication
No quality-control statistics

Evaluation Artifacts Not Disclosed
No prompt or answer parser
No correctness or hallucination grader
Dataset and code are not released

Ask the Person Fact Questions
Evaluate an OpenAI model snapshot
Generate a natural-language answer
Preserve whether an answer is attempted

Evaluate Attempted Answers
Accuracy is defined on answers attempted
Correctness means the answer is right
Exact scoring procedure is not public

Identify Hallucinated Answers
Check how often the model hallucinates
Lower hallucination rate is better
Exact labeling procedure is not public

Report Accuracy
Higher is better
Compare evaluated model snapshots
Keep attempted-answer scope explicit

Report Hallucination Rate
Lower is better
Interpret separately from accuracy
More claims can raise both outcomes

Audit Reference Freshness
Outdated gold facts can overstate errors
Current correct answers may look wrong
Future versions need closer review
